title: Wallbang TP
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local locations = {
    ["1"] = Vector3.new(-247.74, 15.13, 220.04),   
    ["2"] = Vector3.new(-203.77, 2.19, 124.52),   
    ["3"] = Vector3.new(-76.55, 5.36, 145.84),      
    ["4"] = Vector3.new(-57.43, 9.37, 212.21),      
    ["5"] = Vector3.new(-144.64, 5.28, 183.92),     
}

local function teleportTo(locationName)
    local pos = locations[locationName]
    if pos then
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        print("Teleported to Location " .. locationName)
    else
        print("Invalid location. Use 1-5")
    end
end

player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
    local cmd = message:lower():match("^/tp%s+(%d)$")
    if cmd then
        teleportTo(cmd)
    end
end)

local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end
    
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Four then
        teleportTo("1")
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Five then
        teleportTo("2")
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Six then
        teleportTo("3")
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Seven then
        teleportTo("4")
    elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Eight then
        teleportTo("5")
    end
end)
--yes opensource and made by me as you can see very simple but very op
features: Basic but overpowered script that teleports you to locations you can bug into legitimately that allows you to wallbang/shoot any enemey player across the entire map
